Know the market: Track industry trends, competitive movements, and emerging opportunities across your regions to inform strategy and identify new areas for growth.

8+ years of experience in sales, business development, or account management, with a focus on selling data products, SaaS, or API-based solutions.

The Role: The Lead Account Manager is a strategic, customer-facing player-coach responsible for managing a portfolio of high-value accounts while helping build a more consistent and scalable account management function across Interra Health.

Lead joint planning conversations with customers to uncover growth opportunities and deepen platform adoption. Surface friction points — product gaps, support patterns, onboarding challenges — in a data-informed way that drives action across the business. Serve as the primary voice of the customer for the segment, contributing structured insights to roadmap, packaging, and go-to-market decisions.

Support the transition from product-based to segment-based account management, helping shape structure and process along the way.

What You’ll Bring: Degree & Years of Experience: Typically requires 7+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, or a similar post-sale commercial role, along with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Knowledge & Application: Brings deep knowledge of account management practices, customer health methodologies, and SaaS commercial models, ideally in healthcare technology. Operates independently, prioritizes effectively across a complex portfolio, and exercises sound judgment in managing renewals, customer risk, and growth opportunities.

Complexity & Problem Solving: Navigates complex, multi-stakeholder customer situations involving renewal risk, product limitations, organizational change, or competitive pressure. Identifies patterns across accounts and translates them into scalable solutions, process improvements, and escalation priorities.

Creates practical frameworks and reporting approaches where they do not yet exist. Collaboration & Interaction: Works cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Support, Marketing, Operations, and executive leadership.

Coaches others while owning a strategic book of business and serves as a key conduit between the field and leadership by translating customer and segment signals into actionable recommendations.

Nothing gets lost. Actions, decisions, and open questions are captured and easy for others to pick up.

Clients find you responsive, clear, and easy to work with.

s.h: About The Role (and Challenges You’ll Be Helping To Solve!)
s.t:
We want to add an experienced Account Executive (Enterprise - Brands/Retail) to our Corporate team who will manage an enterprise portfolio and drive retention and growth across a portfolio of existing clients within our corporate sector. The goal is to position YipitData's must-have products and ensure successful renewals, as well as identify new buying centers and upsell opportunities within existing clients.
The Account Executive will own the commercial relationship for existing business, be responsible for identifying and closing upsell opportunities, have a relationship with budget owners and key decision makers, and own the renewal process. You will be responsible for creating advocates for our products and helping them find answers to their key questions by collaborating closely with our solutions and client strategy teams to provide a "must have" service to our clients.
This remote-friendly opportunity can sit in NYC (where our headquarters is located), one of our office hubs (Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, or Seattle), or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding. Please note that we pay NYC-based salaries for US roles regardless of where employees choose to work.

s.t:
You have at least 4+ years of experience in subscription and/or data sales to large Enterprise Retailers and Brands
You have experience managing the holistic life cycle of a client relationship from onboarding, quarterly business reviews, renewal, and upsells
You have experience selling into large enterprises, negotiating contracts with sophisticated procurement teams, and liaising with senior executives across several business functions such as strategy, sales, marketing, and data/insights.
You have experience managing a book of business and or selling a new complex product or service.
You have a track record of not only meeting but exceeding sales goals

You are resourceful, resilient, and have strong oral and written communication - including great questioning - skills
You have an entrepreneurial spirit and are excited to help build a newer business from the ground up
You love solving ambiguous problems and are willing to persevere through the highs and lows of creating something new

About Nivoda 🚀
Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.
Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry.

Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

Our Sales team is the engine that brings Nivoda's mission to life. We're a high-energy, globally distributed group that moves fast, owns outcomes, and genuinely cares about the success of every jewellery business we work with. This is a team that thrives on commercial creativity, deep customer relationships, and relentless execution and we're growing fast.

You take a booked demo and turn it into a live, transacting Nivoda customer. That means running a compelling demo of the marketplace, navigating commercial negotiation, closing the contract, shepherding the customer through KYC/onboarding compliance, and owning the account through its first 90 days — first search, first order, first reorder.
This is not a pure "close and toss" role. The first 90 days are where marketplace customers form habits or churn silently, so you are accountable for activation, not just signature. You need to understand how two-sided marketplaces work — liquidity, supply trust, transaction mechanics — and ideally how the jewellery trade buys.
What will you be doing? 😎
Run discovery-led demos that map Nivoda's marketplace to the retailer's actual buying workflow.
Manage the deal: proposal, commercial terms, objection handling, multi-stakeholder buy-in, close.
Drive KYC and compliance to completion without letting momentum die — chase documents, unblock friction.
Own days 0–90: get the customer searching, quoting, and placing first orders; set usage habits early.
Coordinate with SDRs on handoff quality and with AMs on a clean day-90 transition (account context, buying patterns, risks).
Forecast accurately and keep pipeline stages honest.
What do we need from you? 💪
3–6 years closing experience, with background in a marketplace (B2B or transactional B2C — think platforms where you sold liquidity and trust, not just software) or in the jewellery/diamond industry with commercial exposure.
You understand marketplace dynamics: why the first transaction matters more than the contract, how supply breadth wins deals, what makes buyers switch procurement behaviour.
Strong demo craft: you sell workflows and outcomes, not feature tours.
Comfortable with operational follow-through — KYC, onboarding, activation — because signature is the midpoint, not the finish line.
Structured negotiator; calm with pushback on pricing and terms.
KPIs
Demo-to-close conversion, closed contracts/new business revenue
KYC completion time
90-day activation rate (first order + reorder)
Day-90 account value at handoff
Forecast accuracy

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.
So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff.

Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place.

Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.
Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. Join our team to help Public Sector organizations in Central America and the Caribbean transform their operations through cloud technology. As an Account Executive, you'll build meaningful partnerships with education sector leaders and drive their adoption of Amazon Web Services while establishing AWS as a trusted technology partner in the region.

· Drive revenue growth and market expansion in your defined territory and industry vertical by identifying opportunities, qualifying prospects, and closing deals that meet quarterly targets.
· Develop and execute comprehensive account and territory plans that outline your strategy for customer engagement, market penetration, and revenue growth.
· Build and articulate compelling value propositions that connect AWS services to the specific business challenges and goals of Public Sector education organizations.
· Cultivate strategic relationships with key accounts and stakeholders at all levels, from C-suite executives to technical teams, ensuring long-term partnership and customer satisfaction.
· Collaborate with partners and internal teams to extend market reach, accelerate customer adoption, and support customers through contract negotiations and implementation.
A day in the life
In this role, you'll focus on expanding AWS adoption within the Public Sector education sector across Central America and the Caribbean. You'll spend your time connecting with decision-makers at all levels—from C-suite executives to technical architects—to understand their unique challenges and show how AWS solutions can address them.

Your days will include developing territory strategies, crafting presentations that highlight the value of AWS services, and nurturing relationships that lead to long-term partnerships. You'll also collaborate with our partner ecosystem to extend our reach and support customers through their cloud journey.

This is a role where you'll balance strategic relationship-building with hands-on execution, working independently to hit quarterly targets while staying connected to our broader team's mission.

We are building a dynamic Public Sector business in Central America and the Caribbean, and we're looking for collaborative partners who share our vision of making cloud technology accessible and valuable to education organizations in the region.

Our team thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where innovation and customer success drive everything we do. You'll work alongside sales professionals, solution architects, and partners who are committed to understanding customer needs and delivering tailored solutions.

Together, we're establishing AWS as a key technology platform provider in markets where we're just beginning to build our presence. If you're excited about being part of something new and making a tangible impact on how organizations adopt cloud technology, this team is for you.
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.
Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.
Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.
How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

As an Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.
By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.
This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota-carrying seller. You’ll partner cross-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add-on SKUs, and build deep, long-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.
Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.
This is a hybrid role, in office 3 days a week in Paris.

Own NRR: Manage the full post-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.
Drive Growth: Identify and activate growth opportunities within your portfolio, prospecting into new subsidiaries, use cases, and additional SKUs to unlock untapped potential.
Target Strategically: Prioritize high-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long-term growth plans.
Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.
Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.
Sell Competitively: Position Aircall’s value head-to-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer’s unique business needs.
Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty.
Manage Pipeline & Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data-driven NRR forecasting.
Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall’s product roadmap and go-to-market strategies.
Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives.

Experienced in SaaS Account Management, Commercial Customer Success, or Renewal Management, with a track record of achieving revenue targets.
Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy.
Customer-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.
Capable of developing and executing account expansion strategies, including stakeholder mapping and whitespace analysis.
Confident in competitive sales cycles, able to articulate differentiation and handle objections effectively.
Analytical, detail-oriented, and accountable for forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene.
Resilient, driven, and passionate about helping customers realize long-term value through partnership.
Excited by innovation and transformation — particularly the opportunity to represent a next-generation AI-powered communications platform.

Industry: Business AI Platform Subscriptions
Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full-time
Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM AEST
Primary Tools: GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM, Zoom

We are seeking a commercially sharp, high-performing Business Development Manager to drive pipeline generation and close deals live on Zoom for our AI subscription platform.
This position owns the end-to-end sales lifecycle directly within GoHighLevel (GHL)—covering prospecting, multi-channel outbound outreach, inbound lead follow-up, demo booking, discovery, live product demonstrations, objection handling, and one-call closes (no formal proposals sent).

You will sell directly to small to medium business (SMB) owners, solopreneurs, coaches, and service-based business leaders. Additionally, you will coordinate seamless post-sale handovers to guarantee rapid onboarding and exceptional customer satisfaction.
What You Will Sell (AUD)
Business AI Platform Annual Subscriptions (Includes AI Yourself )

Pipeline Generation (Outbound & Inbound): Build targeted prospect lists aligned with our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP). Execute multi-channel outreach via GHL (email, SMS, calls, social touchpoints). Respond to inbound inquiries instantly with rigorous follow-up cadences.
Qualification & Discovery: Qualify leads based on fit, urgency, financial capacity, and decision-maker authority. Conduct structured discovery calls to unpack business pain points and desired outcomes; quickly disconfirm non-fits to preserve focus.
Live Demos & One-Call Closing: Execute high-impact Zoom demos communicating clear ROI, outcomes, and immediate action steps. Address objections confidently and close deals live using approved pricing and offer frameworks. Collect onboarding and payment details on the spot.
CRM Hygiene & Pipeline Forecasting: Maintain flawless GHL records (lead sources, activity logs, deal stages, and task schedules). Track daily/weekly operational metrics and deliver reliable pipeline forecasts using GHL analytics.
Handover & Customer Experience: Deliver clean, immediate handovers to customer success to accelerate onboarding. Identify strategic add-on, upsell, and referral opportunities during the transition.
Continuous Improvement: Refine scripts, messaging sequences, and audience targeting based on live call data. Share win/loss feedback to help optimize product positioning and onboarding workflows.

Experience: 3+ years of success in B2B or B2C high-ticket sales, consultative sales, or business development.
Full-Funnel Capability: Proven ability to independently prospect, run discovery, and close (not just appointment setting).
Communication: Exceptional verbal, Zoom presence, and written English skills; highly comfortable guiding business owners to decisive buying actions.
Tech Stack: Proficiency with sales workflows and CRMs; direct experience with GoHighLevel (GHL) is strongly preferred.
Execution & Integrity: Highly structured with tasks, calendar management, and call notes. Operates with strict ethical standards (zero high-pressure tactics or exaggerated claims).
Compliance & Guardrails
Pricing Governance: Pricing and offer structures are fixed. Unauthorized discounting or custom deals are strictly prohibited.
Policy Compliance: Adhere strictly to company guidelines regarding data privacy, confidential information handling, compliant outreach practices, opt-out management, and accurate product representation.
Refund Policy: Customers receive comprehensive onboarding and support. Refunds are not provided for change of mind and are reviewed strictly on an exceptional basis at management discretion.

Sales at Uber for Business means navigating ambiguity, earning trust fast, and solving problems that don't come with a script. It's not about pushing a product - it's about building long-term partnerships in a fast-changing environment.
As an Account Executive in Ciudad de México, you will sit at the intersection of strategic acquisition and portfolio growth for our highest-value AAA accounts. You will manage complex, long-term sales cycles and lead large-scale integration projects that require deep cross-functional collaboration across operations, product, and legal.
This role requires an unyielding work ethic, strong professional integrity, and the resilience to navigate tough negotiations and shifting market dynamics. If you're energized by the messy reality of doing big things at scale, this is where you'll grow.

Build and grow long-term partnerships: Manage Mid Market / Enterprise sales lifecycles across both net-new AAA business acquisition and strategic expansion of existing high-value accounts.
Lead large-scale complex projects: Oversee multifaceted deal structuring, integration rollouts, and cross-functional execution involving multiple high-level Mid Market / Enterprise stakeholders.
Navigate commercial ambiguity: Adapt sales strategies to complex local market dynamics, long decision-making timelines, and changing client requirements.
Negotiate high-impact terms: Secure mutual economic value through creative deal structuring, effectively overcoming pricing pushbacks and client objections.
Manage pipelines with urgency and discipline: Leverage CRM tools (Salesforce) to maintain strict data hygiene, track account health indicators, and ensure accurate forecasting.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Work with operations, product, marketing, and legal teams to shape customer proposals, resolve operational blockers, and scale solutions.

5+ years of professional experience in Mid market / Enterprise, Account Management, or Business Development managing complex commercial sales cycles.
Proven track record of acquiring and growing Mid Market / Enterprise AAA accounts and executing large-scale, complex projects.
Demonstrated experience navigating long sales cycles while balancing both new business (\"hunter\") and portfolio growth (\"farmer\") strategies.
Strong professional work ethics, integrity, and personal accountability.
Professional fluency in Spanish and English with strong presentation and stakeholder management skills.
Saas experience.

Deep knowledge of the LATAM commercial ecosystem and Mid Market / Enterprise verticals in Mexico.
Experience in technology platforms, marketplace logistics, or high-growth environments.
Proficiency in Salesforce (SFDC) or enterprise CRM software.
Strong data-driven commercial storytelling capabilities to influence senior decision-makers.
